en.headline: Korean illustration pop-up continues at D2 Place in Lai Chi Kok
en.dek: Eight Korean brands, several making their Hong Kong debut, sell plush toys, charms and stationery at the store until 22 November.
body: A Korean illustration pop-up store is open at D2 Place TWO in Lai Chi Kok, running daily from noon until 8pm until 22 November.
The event, organised with partners KOTRA Hong Kong and D2 Place, brings together eight Korean illustration brands. Several of the brands are making their first appearance in Hong Kong.

Shoppers can find plush toys, charms, blind-box figures, phone accessories, postcards, stickers, washi tape and other lifestyle items. Character standees are available for photographs, and a gift is offered with purchases while stocks last.
The pop-up occupies Shop P2P on the ground floor of D2 Place TWO.

zh.headline: 韓國插畫品牌期間限定店續於荔枝角D2 Place開放
zh.dek: 八個韓國品牌（部分為香港首度登場）於荔枝角D2 Place售賣毛公仔、掛飾及文具，至11月22日止。
body: 一間韓國插畫品牌期間限定店目前於荔枝角D2 Place二期開放，每日中午12時至晚上8時，直至11月22日。
活動由韓國貿易振興公司香港辦事處及D2 Place合作舉辦，集合八個韓國插畫品牌，其中部分品牌屬香港首度登場。
店內售賣毛公仔、掛飾、盲盒公仔、手機配件、明信片、貼紙、和紙膠帶及其他生活用品。現場設有角色立牌可供拍照，購物亦有禮品贈送，送完即止。
期間限定店位於D2 Place二期地下P2P舖。
